fixes.issues: v01 (the only candidate) has a good composition. Nagoji sits at the verandah edge facing the rain, and Revathi arrives under the eaves at left, rain-damp, with the right costume. fixes.issues: v01 is the only candidate. It carries over the 11.5 staging well: Nagoji on the left holding his hand out, Revathi on the right, the carved pillar and lit doorways behind her, and the rain. Two faults rule it out. First, a clear red sindoor streak is painted in Revathi's hair parting. MUST MATCH forbids this, and it would mark the widow as married.
